description: Goblins. They are vulgar monsters, ubiquitous... at least, that`s how humans perceive them. On this day, a young adventurer named Ilari set out to slay goblins, hoping to make a name for himself. Unaware that this was the beginning of a tragedy... "I will hunt down every monster in this nest!" Ilari was utterly ignorant and foolish. It was too late to realize his own inferiority to the goblins.

titles.title: 駆け出し冒険者 イラーリ
